scope: Reverse distributed device-grid rounding: four directions, three wrap modes, three distributed alignments, scales 1/1.5/2, physical start padding 0/14/14.25, 2-5 children, plus original intrinsic counterexample
limitations: Headless actual GPUI TestWindow and MoonBit full geometry only; no desktop or pixel parity.
Device-grid distributed zero-flex precision only; raw Double and huge finite geometry fallback remain outside f32 path.

Compatibility path excludes Percent basis/authored main-size lines and nonzero absolute container main-axis origin; sizes must be Float-exact and snapped far edges must agree, otherwise prior Double path is preserved.
